$meta.name: L Key Design Tokens
$meta.source: DESIGN.md is authoritative. Where DESIGN.md is silent, values come from the committed design system at .claude/skills/L_Key_Design_System. Nothing here is invented. See docs/adr/0003-design-token-source-of-truth.md.
$meta.warning: Edit this file only. Generated output is written by build.mjs and verified by `npm run tokens:check`.

color.$comment: DESIGN.md §5 light ramp, §6 dark ramp. Status colours fill a DESIGN.md silence.

white.source: surface for cards on the off-white ground

grey400.source: DESIGN.md §5 — decorative only, fails AA as text on any L Key ground

danger.source: gap-fill — DESIGN.md §38 requires error states but names no colour

success.source: gap-fill — DESIGN.md §56 requires status display but names no colour

dangerDark.source: gap-fill — #BA1A1A is 2.92:1 on the dark surface; DESIGN.md §68 forbids simply inverting

successDark.source: gap-fill — #1E7A34 is 3.50:1 on the dark surface

typography.$comment: DESIGN.md §8 families, §9 scale, §10 tracking. lineHeight is a unitless multiplier; letterSpacing is in em so it scales with size.

myanmar.source: gap-fill — the three brand faces carry no Burmese glyphs; see docs/adr/0006-myanmar-font-fallback.md

myanmarLineHeight.source: DESIGN.md §36 requires Burmese font size and line wrapping be tested rather than assumed; Burmese stacked diacritics clip at the Latin line heights, which are as tight as 0.95

hero.source: design system tokens/typography.css --lk-size-hero; the tuner note, DESIGN.md §21 "the detected note should be huge"

h4.source: design system --lk-size-h4 18 / --lk-lh-h4 28; DESIGN.md §9 names no display step at 18

spacing.$comment: DESIGN.md §14 — 4px base. Key is the multiple of 4.

radius.$comment: DESIGN.md §12 — 0 is the default, 4 and 8 are deliberate exceptions.

pill.source: circular avatars and play buttons only

shadow.$comment: DESIGN.md §13 — hard offsets, blur is always 0.

animation.$comment: DESIGN.md §41 requires motion be short, functional and predictable but names no values. These come from the committed design system, not invention.

pressTranslate.source: DESIGN.md §15 translate toward the shadow; magnitude from design system --lk-press-translate

dimension.$comment: DESIGN.md names no component dimensions. Values come from the committed design system and from the WCAG 2.5.5 minimum.

buttonHeightSm.source: design system components/core/AppButton.prompt.md "sm 26px"; measured 26.39 rounded up to the DESIGN.md §14 4px grid so the control clears its line box

buttonHeightMd.source: design system components/core/AppButton.jsx sm/md/lg/xl/hero ladder, md

buttonHeightLg.source: design system components/core/AppButton.jsx ladder, lg — the default mobile button

buttonHeightHero.source: design system components/core/AppButton.prompt.md "hero 61px"; measured 60.8 rounded up to the 4px grid

iconBoxSm.source: design system components/core/AppIconButton.jsx painted box, small

iconBoxLg.source: design system components/core/AppIconButton.jsx large, used for the Quick Tune play control

iconBoxCircle.source: design system ui_kits/mobile_app/HomeScreen.jsx Import Tab circular mark

textFieldMinHeight.source: design system components/core/AppTextField.jsx minHeight 45.59 rounded up to the 4px grid and to WCAG 2.5.5

navItemMinWidth.source: design system components/navigation/BottomNavBar.prompt.md "active tab becomes a 64px Guitar Orange block"

navIconSlot.source: design system components/navigation/BottomNavBar.jsx icon slot height 18, rounded up to the 4px grid

chordDiagramWidth.source: design system components/music/ChordDiagram.jsx default width — the 342px card minus 32px padding either side

chordNutHeight.source: design system components/music/ChordDiagram.jsx nut bar height

chordStringWidth.source: design system components/music/ChordDiagram.jsx string line width

chordFretLineWidth.source: design system components/music/ChordDiagram.jsx fret line height

chordMarkerSize.source: design system components/music/ChordDiagram.jsx finger marker box

fretboardFretWidthCompact.source: design system ui_kits/mobile_app/ToolsScreens.jsx ScalesScreen fretWidth — the phone-width neck

fretboardStringWidth.source: design system components/music/Fretboard.jsx string line height

fretboardFretLineWidth.source: design system components/music/Fretboard.jsx fret line width

fretboardNutWidth.source: design system components/music/Fretboard.jsx first fret line width

fretboardLabelColumn.source: design system components/music/Fretboard.jsx string-name column width, widened to carry the guitarist string number beside the note (DESIGN.md §25)

tunerMeterHeight.source: design system components/music/TunerMeter.jsx meter track height

tunerNeedleHeight.source: design system components/music/TunerMeter.jsx needle height, overhanging the track

tunerNeedleOverhang.source: design system components/music/TunerMeter.jsx needle top offset

tunerCentsRange.source: design system components/music/TunerMeter.jsx needle clamp, +/- cents across the track

opacity.$comment: Unitless. Kept out of `dimension` because the CSS emitter appends px to every dimension value.

disabled.source: design system guidelines/brand-press.card.html "Disabled is 40% opacity, never a grey re-tint"

stripe.source: design system --lk-stripe; the 45° hatch over an orange progress fill

semantic.$comment: The only layer feature code may reference. Each key resolves to a color token per theme.

contrastPairs.$comment: Verified at build time. `min` is the WCAG ratio the pair must meet: 4.5 for normal text, 3.0 for large text and non-text. The build FAILS below the threshold — this is what stops the 3.37:1 and 2.05:1 regressions the design review found.

pairs.note: body copy on the app ground
grey-400 fails here at 3.11:1; grey-500 is why this passes
orange is a surface colour; black sits on it
WCAG 2.4.11 — the ring must read against the app ground
orange is 2.92:1 on the #F0F0F0 ground, so an orange fill NEVER carries a boundary alone — it always takes a border or hard shadow (DESIGN.md §42, no meaning by colour alone)
the finger number inside a chord-diagram marker
the finger number inside a root marker (DESIGN.md §25)
non-text: the marker dot must read against the diagram card
the root marker is orange; DESIGN.md §42 forbids colour as the only cue, so the diagram also prints the finger number
non-text: string and fret lines must read against the diagram card
